thoughts.question: Life is low: keep fighting, drink, run, portal or leave the game?
thoughts.headline: Life fell to 30% in Blood Moor, with 4 healing potions in the belt and 3 enemies close.
thoughts.ifNothing: If you do nothing: the hero will drink a potion now (a rejuvenation potion first when life is critical). Answer within 45 s or the hero decides.
thoughts.rule: Rule applies when: in act 1, no champion bonus, on Normal, life 26 to 49%, softcore hero, a healing potion at hand, with potions and a portal.
thoughts.context: in act 1, no champion bonus, on Normal, life 26 to 49%, softcore hero, a healing potion at hand, with potions and a portal

choices.label: drink a potion (rejuvenation first when life is critical)
choices.does: drink a potion now (a rejuvenation potion first when life is critical)

choices.label: take a town portal
choices.does: open a town portal and leave the fight

choices.label: leave the game
choices.does: quit the game to be safe

choices.label: keep fighting
choices.does: keep fighting (its normal potion rules still apply)

choices.label: Not sure, you decide
choices.does: let the hero decide this time; nothing is learned

thoughts.meanwhile: Meanwhile I: drink a potion (rejuvenation first when life is critical)
